messages:
lina_cs: Quick weekly cache + batching snapshot for ACRO Health — noticed a regression over the last 48h. TL;DR: hit rate down, avg batch size down, cost per 1k tokens up. Details and asks below.

carla_cs: thanks for the heads up. can you drop the dashboard link?

lina_cs: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/acrohealth/metrics — see the 'cache efficiency' and 'batching' panels. main numbers from Mon->Wed: 
```
hit_rate: 82% -> 67%
avg_batch_size: 24 -> 15
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.12 -> $0.18
p50_latency_per_token: 80ms -> 220ms
5xx_rate: 0.2% -> 1.1%
```
ryan_infra: wow, that's a pretty big shift. any infra deploys or model rollouts coincide with the drop?

lina_cs: they rolled model v2.3 Tue 23:40 UTC (minor perf change). traffic volume ~ stable. noticed a higher percentage of short single-turn prompts from their agents this week.

anya_se: short prompts will kill batching and prefix hit rate. do we have the batch size distribution?

lina_cs: yes — snapshot from last 24h: 
```
batch_size_distribution: {1: 42%, 2-5: 35%, 6-20: 18%, >20: 5%}
prefix_hit_by_len: short_prompts(<=64 tokens): 12% hit, long_prompts(>256): 78% hit
```
jon_prod: ok — if singletons jumped to ~42% that explains both lower hit rate and smaller avg batch. suggestions: (1) try increasing the batching window (min_batch_wait_ms) to 25-30ms for a canary; (2) enable a prefix-only cache policy for long-lived sessions; (3) add client-side batching helper in their SDK.

carla_cs: I'll draft a one-pager with example SDK snippets and quick wins for their integration team. could help them reduce single-call usage.

lina_cs: ask to infra: @ryan_infra can we do a targeted 6-hour canary for ACRO Health that increases the batching window to 30ms and leaves everything else unchanged? monitor p50 & 95, cost per 1k tokens, and 5xx.

ryan_infra: can do. planning window tonight 22:00 PT. will isolate to their tenant and pin model version to v2.3 to avoid confounding. ops-bot: scheduling.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled by ryan_infra for account ACRO Health — start 2026-03-21T05:00Z, duration 6h. Alert hooks: #eng-oncall, #customer-success.

anya_se: i'll run a short synthetic simulation focused on short prompts to estimate expected batchability uplift at +30ms wait. will post results in this thread. initial guess: avg_batch_size could go from 15 -> ~18, hit_rate maybe +3-6pt.

jon_prod: also consider a quick client-side change: add a tiny queue helper that coalesces requests within 20ms before calling API. often easier than server-side tuning.

carla_cs: will include that sample in the doc. also starting an enablement call with the customer on Thurs 10am PT to walk them through SDK patterns.

lina_cs: follow-ups/owners: carla = enablement doc + customer invite; ryan = deploy canary + share canary dashboard link; anya = sim results; jon = sample client helper snippet. If we don't see improvement in cost or latency next weekly check, flag as renewal risk and loop AE.

carla_cs: noted. i'll ping AE and include the one-pager in the renewal pack.

lina_cs: thanks team :pray: — will update thread after canary finishes and we have metrics.
